text: Tap the big AGE button to live another year. Quiet years just scroll by; only big moments pop up.
The bottom bar: Life, Skills, Assets, Work, Social and More. More lists every screen and has a search box.
A red New badge marks something you just unlocked by growing up.
Pick a Passion in Skills. It trains matching skills faster and brings related events.
Grades, clubs, sports and service in high school can win scholarships. Check Work > Scholarships.
At 18 you can open Businesses, invest, shop for cars and homes, and take out loans.
